brand_new.look: Recently built glass and white-stone district, crisp and uniform
brand_new.vegetation: young street trees in grates, manicured planters

mixing_rule.facade: Per building pick exactly 1 role=basic facade for the main body (base floors). Optionally add 1 role=accent facade for the crown/top floors, the ground band, or corners (follow its suggested_use). Adjacent/neighbouring buildings must not reuse the same basic; rotate through the list.
mixing_rule.ground: Per block pick 1 basic of each surface (grass, sidewalk, curb, asphalt). Use worn/accent variants as patches or for whole lots in proportion to wear_level; distressed tiers use accents liberally. Adjacent blocks should not reuse the same basic grass/asphalt where alternatives exist.
